claims.claim: Fyrora distinguishes clear sampling, fire, obscured/non-land and not-observed cells for the audited day.
claims.scope: Western Iberia; 2023-08-06; four Aqua MODIS and four S-NPP VIIRS acquisitions
claims.limitation: One-day observation-support audit; not probability of detection or global completeness

claims.claim: The frozen harmonization method passed its precommitted 2024 three-region transfer gate.
claims.scope: Three unseen 2024 study windows; fixed model and thresholds
claims.limitation: Two regions still have WAPE above 1; this does not establish global accuracy

claims.claim: Harmonized activity is strongly associated with EFFIS mapped burned area.
claims.scope: 201 eligible Western Iberia EFFIS events in 2023
claims.limitation: Precommitted association threshold and bootstrap lower-bound gates failed

claims.claim: Fyrora is ready for live operational incident alerting.
claims.limitation: No live latency/SLA test, multi-season swath validation or passed external-outcome gate

safetyBoundary: Research and planning evidence; not a live alert, burned-area product or emergency-service replacement.
